symbols.name: BenchmarkResult
symbols.documentation:
Fishing multiplier, raw SPR, SSB in tonnes, recruitment in thousands, dead
yield in tonnes and pooled annual F for one equilibrium.
@details scale multiplies the reference fleet/season pattern. spr is raw
SPR, ssb/yield are tonnes, recruitment is thousands of fish and annual_f is
pooled SS3 units 4. Scale and reported annual F are different quantities.
symbols.purpose: Fishing multiplier, raw SPR, SSB in tonnes, recruitment in thousands, dead yield in tonnes and pooled annual F for one equilibrium.

symbols.name: Benchmarks
symbols.documentation:
Equilibrium reference-point calculator holding selected historical
fleet/season fishing proportions and terminal biology.
@details The object borrows data and native parameter maps, which must
outlive it. Rates are scaled proportionally across fleets/seasons; the
annual F output is pooled SS3 units 4 over ages 1..10, not the input
multiplier. Averaging the 2019..2021 fishing pattern answers a different
reference-point question from using terminal-2021 rates.
symbols.purpose: Equilibrium reference-point calculator holding selected historical fleet/season fishing proportions and terminal biology.

symbols.name: Benchmarks::Benchmarks
symbols.signature: Benchmarks::Benchmarks(const InputData & d, const ParameterValues<double> & values, const Deviations<double> & deviations, int first_pattern_year, int last_pattern_year)
symbols.purpose: Construct terminal biology and virgin per-recruit biomass, and average the requested historical fishing-pattern years.

symbols.name: Benchmarks::operator()
symbols.purpose: Solve positive Beverton-Holt recruitment, equilibrium abundance, yield and SS3 units-4 annual F for a nonnegative fishing multiplier.

symbols.name: Benchmarks::target
symbols.signature: BenchmarkResult Benchmarks::target(double value, bool spawning_ratio) const
symbols.purpose: Use bracket expansion and bisection to find a valid fractional SPR or virgin-biomass target.

symbols.name: Benchmarks::msy
symbols.documentation:
Find maximum equilibrium yield through a bracketed fourth-order numerical
derivative root, avoiding flat-objective rounding noise.
@return Equilibrium summaries at the yield-derivative root.
@details The five-point numerical yield derivative avoids comparing almost
equal maxima. Its fixed step and bracket tolerance are checked indirectly
by the two-step forecast uncertainty validation; this is not a global
optimizer for arbitrary selectivity models.
symbols.purpose: Find maximum equilibrium yield through a bracketed fourth-order numerical derivative root, avoiding flat-objective rounding noise.

symbols.name: management_reference_points
symbols.signature: std::vector<std::pair<std::string, BenchmarkResult>> management_reference_points(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<double> & parameters, const Deviations<double> & deviations)
symbols.purpose: Calculate unfished, Btgt20, SPR20 and MSY derived outputs from supplied fitted parameters and deviations using terminal biology and terminal-year fishing mixture. No SS3 reference values enter these calculations.

symbols.name: ParameterValues
symbols.documentation:
Map canonical parameter names to native values of a common scalar type.
@details Keys are canonical control names. Values are native model values,
not logits; all entries used together must share the same scalar
type/evaluation tape. Missing required keys fail through checked map lookup.
symbols.purpose: Map canonical parameter names to native values of a common scalar type.

symbols.name: initial_values
symbols.purpose: Populate a parameter map from control initial values; these may differ from fitted Report.sso values.

symbols.name: logistic
symbols.purpose: Calculate a numerically stable inverse-logit for ordinary or AD scalars.

symbols.name: normal_cdf
symbols.purpose: Approximate the standard normal CDF with scalar-generic operations, enabling differentiation through age-length probabilities.

symbols.name: length_probabilities

symbols.purpose: Integrate normal lengths across lower-edge bins, accumulating the two tails in the end bins and rejecting invalid grids or scale.

symbols.name: length_at_age
symbols.signature: T length_at_age(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, int sex, int age, double year_fraction)
symbols.purpose: Calculate sex-specific mean length with the supplied birth timing, seasonal growth and SS3 plus-group growth adjustment.

symbols.name: length_sd

symbols.purpose: Interpolate age-dependent length variability and convert its coefficient of variation to a standard deviation.

symbols.name: age_length_key

symbols.purpose: Return bin probabilities for one sex, age and within-year time using fitted growth parameters.

symbols.name: length_midpoint
symbols.signature: double length_midpoint(const InputData & data, size_t bin)
symbols.purpose: Map a population length-bin lower edge to its integration midpoint, including the final bin convention.

symbols.name: weight_at_length
symbols.signature: T weight_at_length(const ParameterValues<T> & p, int sex, double length)
symbols.purpose: Evaluate the sex-specific length-weight power relationship; length is cm and individual weight is kg.

symbols.name: maturity_at_length
symbols.signature: T maturity_at_length(const ParameterValues<T> & p, double length)
symbols.purpose: Evaluate the length-based logistic female maturity curve from its midpoint and slope.

symbols.name: weight_at_age
symbols.signature: T weight_at_age(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, int sex, int age, double time)
symbols.purpose: Integrate individual weight over the age-length key at a supplied within-year time.

symbols.name: maturity_integration_time
symbols.purpose: Locate the start of the subseason containing spawning, matching the supplied SS3 maturity integration convention.

symbols.name: mature_weight_at_age
symbols.signature: T mature_weight_at_age(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, int age)
symbols.purpose: Integrate mature female biomass contribution across length bins, respecting the first mature age.

symbols.name: selectivity_period
symbols.signature: std::vector<int> selectivity_period(const InputData & data, int year)
symbols.purpose: Build a discrete block-activity cache key for a year; use only within one evaluation to avoid reusing AD tape vertices.

symbols.name: effective_selectivity_parameter
symbols.signature: T effective_selectivity_parameter(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, int fleet, int index, int year)
symbols.purpose: Resolve a fleet selectivity parameter with year-specific replacement blocks and canonical parameter mapping.

symbols.name: length_selectivity
symbols.signature: std::vector<std::vector<T>> length_selectivity(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, int year)
symbols.purpose: Build fleet length-selectivity curves for supported constant, logistic, double-normal and mirror patterns, including active blocks.

symbols.name: SelectedAge
symbols.documentation:
Integrated selectivity in numbers and biomass, with selected mean length and
weight for a sex/age cell.
@details numbers is integrated number selectivity; biomass integrates
selectivity times individual kg weight. mean_length and mean_weight describe
selected fish, not the entire unselected population.
symbols.purpose: Integrated selectivity in numbers and biomass, with selected mean length and weight for a sex/age cell.

symbols.name: selected_at_age
symbols.signature: SelectedAge<T> selected_at_age(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, const std::vector<T> & curve, int sex, int age, double time)
symbols.purpose: Integrate fleet length selectivity and weight over an age-length key to obtain selected-at-age summary quantities.

symbols.name: control_start_values
symbols.signature: std::pair<ParameterValues<double>, Deviations<double>> control_start_values(const InputData & data, bool match_fixed_growth)
symbols.purpose: Return literal control native values and zero historical recruitment deviations. An explicit matched-fixed sensitivity changes only male L1 from 83.2 to 83.4; no fitted free parameters or report values are read.

symbols.name: ControlStartPhase
symbols.documentation:
Restrict optimization to one control activation phase, retaining inactive
values. The full model owns the objective and native bounds. base is a
fitting vector, not a native parameter map, so selection introduces no extra
transformation.
symbols.purpose: Active-coordinate view of the independent control-start model. Inactive coordinates remain at its checkpoint; the optional catch-only objective is a documented feasibility stage for an otherwise undefined full likelihood.

symbols.signature: ControlStartPhase::ControlStartPhase(swordfish::SwordfishModel & m, std::vector<double> point, int phase, bool feasibility)
symbols.documentation:
Borrow a model and copy the full coordinate checkpoint for an activation
phase.
symbols.purpose: Select independent coordinates using original control activation phases: 1, 8, 64 and 84 active values. Early deviations activate in phase 4 and main deviations in phase 3.

symbols.name: ControlStartPhase::parameter_names_impl
symbols.documentation:
Return active names in optimizer order, preserving the original full
ordering.
symbols.purpose: Return the active canonical coordinate labels in unchanged full-model order.

symbols.name: ControlStartPhase::expand
symbols.documentation:
Expand active coordinates into the full fitting vector, keeping inactive
values fixed.
symbols.purpose: Expand active values into the complete bounded-logit vector while preserving all inactive checkpoint coordinates.

symbols.name: ControlStartPhase::operator()
symbols.documentation:
Evaluate the full final-phase likelihood through the active-coordinate
map.
symbols.purpose: Evaluate the same final weighted joint target, or catch-only feasibility when explicitly enabled. Neither path reads SS3 estimates or saved covariance.

symbols.signature: T ControlStartPhase::evaluate_impl(const std::vector<T> & point, quadra::ModelReportContext & ) const
symbols.purpose: Expose the restricted scalar objective through the public Quadra model evaluation interface.

symbols.name: csv_line

symbols.name: csv_fields
symbols.purpose: Split the explicit unquoted CSV dialect while preserving trailing empty fields; quoted and multiline fields are rejected.

symbols.name: State
symbols.documentation:
Fixed 2-sex by 16-age abundance array. Cells are thousands of fish; age 15
is the plus group.
@details Index with cell(sex,age), not a one-based SS3 sex/age code. Use
zero_state before accumulation: default construction of supported AD types
is not a numerical-zero contract.
symbols.purpose: Fixed 2-sex by 16-age abundance array. Cells are thousands of fish; age 15 is the plus group.

symbols.name: zero_state
symbols.purpose: Construct an explicitly zero-filled sex-by-age state, including AD scalars whose default constructor does not initialize a numerical zero.

symbols.name: cell
symbols.purpose: Map zero-based sex and age to the flattened 32-cell population-state index; callers supply sex 0-1 and age 0-15.

symbols.name: Dimensions
symbols.purpose: Assessment calendar, four seasonal durations, spawning month, area count and plus-group age.

symbols.name: Fleet
symbols.documentation:
One-based fleet identity, type, observation timing, catch units, multiplier
flag and source name.
@details id is one-based and matches observation records. type distinguishes
fishing/index fleets; catch_units=1 is biomass and 2 is numbers. timing
controls point versus integrated sampling. This schema has one area and no
supported catch multipliers.
symbols.purpose: One-based fleet identity, type, observation timing, catch units, multiplier flag and source name.

symbols.name: Catch
symbols.purpose: One observed fleet-season catch with year, value and log-scale standard error; fleet units select tonnes or thousands of fish.

symbols.name: Index
symbols.documentation:
Abundance-index observation and inclusion flag with source month, fleet,
positive observation and log standard error.
@details month retains source fractional timing; value and log_se must be
positive for included lognormal observations. use controls inclusion without
deleting provenance rows. Special recruitment-unit indices are handled
explicitly in the likelihood.
symbols.purpose: Abundance-index observation and inclusion flag with source month, fleet, positive observation and log standard error.

symbols.name: Composition
symbols.documentation:
Length-composition sample, inclusion flag, sex/partition coding, sample size
and both source blocks of 51 bins.
@details values retains both 51-bin source blocks. For the supplied
combined-sex data the second block duplicates the first and is not a second
independent sample. Negative source years set use=false; sample_size already
contains the supplied weighting.
symbols.purpose: Length-composition sample, inclusion flag, sex/partition coding, sample size and both source blocks of 51 bins.

symbols.name: Parameter
symbols.documentation:
Named SS3 control specification, original numeric columns and source line
for provenance.
@details columns preserves the source control order: lower, upper, initial
and estimation metadata. Estimated phases are read from column 6; extended
selectivity rows also carry block number/function in columns 12/13.
source_line supports diagnostics.
symbols.purpose: Named SS3 control specification, original numeric columns and source line for provenance.

symbols.name: Growth
symbols.documentation:
Sex-specific von Bertalanffy reference ages/lengths, coefficient of
variation and length-weight coefficients.
@details Lengths are cm and k is annual. Reference lengths are tied to
age1/age2; cv_young/cv_old are coefficients of variation, not length SDs.
weight_coefficient and weight_power map individual cm length to kg weight.
symbols.purpose: Sex-specific von Bertalanffy reference ages/lengths, coefficient of variation and length-weight coefficients.

symbols.name: Biology
symbols.documentation:
Fixed natural mortality, sex-specific growth, maturity, sex allocation and
settlement settings.
@details natural_mortality is sex-major annual M. growth has one record per
sex; maturity and settlement settings describe the supplied control setup.
Fitted native parameter maps remain authoritative for parameters evaluated
by the biological functions.
symbols.purpose: Fixed natural mortality, sex-specific growth, maturity, sex allocation and settlement settings.

symbols.name: InputData
symbols.documentation:
Complete supported swordfish observation and control schema; unsupported SS3
variants are rejected rather than approximated silently.
@details This object owns parsed observations and controls; no trajectory
from Report.sso is a population driver. Arrays preserve source codes and
ordering, and validate checks the explicitly supported schema. Further
method-specific layout checks occur before likelihood/projection evaluation.
symbols.purpose: Complete supported swordfish observation and control schema; unsupported SS3 variants are rejected rather than approximated silently.

symbols.name: InputData::validate
symbols.documentation:
Check supported dimensions, season durations, mortality, fleet/catch
definitions and growth before evaluating the imported data.
symbols.purpose: Check supported dimensions, season durations, mortality, fleet/catch definitions and growth before evaluating the imported data.

symbols.name: validate_parameter_covariance
symbols.documentation:
Require a nonempty finite, symmetric, positive-definite parameter covariance
before propagation; do not regularize silently.
@param covariance Square, finite, symmetric positive-definite covariance of
independent fitting coordinates.
symbols.purpose: Require a nonempty finite, symmetric, positive-definite parameter covariance before propagation; do not regularize silently.

symbols.name: delta_covariance
symbols.signature: Eigen::MatrixXd delta_covariance(const Eigen::MatrixXd & jacobian, const Eigen::MatrixXd & covariance)
symbols.purpose: Propagate a compatible finite output Jacobian through the full parameter covariance as J V J-transpose, preserving correlations.

symbols.name: PositiveInterval
symbols.documentation:
Native standard error and positive lower/upper pointwise log-scale Wald
endpoints.
@details se is native-scale delta-method uncertainty. lower/upper are
positive log-scale Wald endpoints, so their arithmetic midpoint need not
equal the estimate. No process uncertainty is added.
symbols.purpose: Native standard error and positive lower/upper pointwise log-scale Wald endpoints.

symbols.name: positive_delta_interval
symbols.purpose: Construct a pointwise positive 95% interval from a positive estimate and nonnegative native variance; reject nonfinite results.

symbols.name: exposure
symbols.signature: T exposure(const T & z, double duration)
symbols.purpose: Calculate the stable Baranov exposure (1-exp(-Z*duration))/Z, using a near-zero expansion; Z is an annual rate and duration is years.

symbols.name: SeasonResult
symbols.documentation:
Seasonal survivors, natural deaths and fleet catch numbers, all on the same
thousands-of-fish scale as the starting state.
@details survivors and natural_deaths are sex-major states; catch_numbers is
indexed by fleet then sex/age. advance_season writes every returned cell.
Numbers are thousands, so population mass balance is tested on that common
scale.
symbols.purpose: Seasonal survivors, natural deaths and fleet catch numbers, all on the same thousands-of-fish scale as the starting state.

symbols.name: advance_season
symbols.signature: SeasonResult<T> advance_season(const State<T> & numbers, const State<double> & m, const std::vector<State<T>> & fleet_f, double duration)
symbols.purpose: Apply natural and fleet fishing mortality over a fraction of a year, returning survivors and separately attributed removals without altering the input state.

symbols.name: age_on_january_first
symbols.purpose: Advance survivors one age at the calendar-year boundary, retain accumulated ages in the plus group and clear age zero.

symbols.name: settle
symbols.signature: void settle(State<T> & numbers, const T & recruits, Fraction female_fraction)
symbols.purpose: Mutate age-zero abundance by adding recruitment allocated to females and males using the supplied female fraction.

symbols.name: spawning_biomass
symbols.signature: T spawning_biomass(const State<T> & numbers, const State<double> & m, const std::vector<State<T>> & fleet_f, const std::array<double, nage> & mature_weight, double elapsed)
symbols.purpose: Calculate female mature biomass after survival to a calendar-correct within-season spawning time.

symbols.name: spawning_biomass_ss33020
symbols.signature: T spawning_biomass_ss33020(const State<T> & numbers, const State<double> & m, const std::vector<State<T>> & fleet_f, const std::array<double, nage> & mature_weight, double calendar_elapsed, double season_duration)
symbols.purpose: Reproduce the legacy SS3 v3.30.20 spawning-survival timing convention used by the supplied benchmark, deliberately distinct from the calendar-correct helper.

symbols.name: mean_length
symbols.signature: double mean_length(double real_age, const Growth & g, double length_at_birth)
symbols.purpose: Evaluate the ordinary von Bertalanffy growth curve at a real age using fixed growth settings and length at birth.

symbols.signature: T beverton_holt(const T & ssb, const T & r0, const T & b0, H h)
symbols.purpose: Return expected recruitment from spawning biomass, virgin recruitment, virgin spawning biomass and steepness; retain scalar-generic derivatives.

symbols.name: likelihood_weight
symbols.signature: double likelihood_weight(const InputData & data, int component, int fleet, int phase)
symbols.purpose: Resolve a component/fleet likelihood lambda at the requested estimation phase.

symbols.name: variance_adjustment
symbols.signature: double variance_adjustment(const InputData & data, int kind, int fleet, double initial)
symbols.purpose: Apply a parsed variance adjustment for an observation kind and fleet to its initial error value.

symbols.purpose: Return a checked reference to one historical year-season row; reject missing or out-of-range calendar positions.

symbols.name: ObservationTime
symbols.purpose: Resolved season, within-year observation time, age-length-key time and elapsed seasonal survival duration.

symbols.name: observation_time
symbols.signature: ObservationTime observation_time(const InputData & data, int fleet, double month)
symbols.purpose: Translate a source observation month and fleet timing setting into the season and exposure times used for index and composition prediction.

symbols.purpose: Sex-specific cached age-length keys for a single within-year time in one likelihood evaluation.

symbols.signature: std::array<std::vector<T>, 2> sampled_lengths(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, const PopulationSeason<T> & row, const std::vector<T> & curve, const ObservationTime & time, const LengthKeys<T> * cached)
symbols.purpose: Project selected surviving numbers into sex-specific sampled length frequencies for an observation time.

symbols.signature: T stabilized_catch_nll(double observed, const T & predicted, double se)
symbols.purpose: Evaluate SS3's stabilized log catch residual penalty for observed and predicted fleet-unit catch.

symbols.name: selectivity_soft_bounds
symbols.signature: T selectivity_soft_bounds(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p)
symbols.purpose: Evaluate the supported symmetric-beta soft-bound penalty on estimated selectivity parameters.

symbols.name: recruitment_nll
symbols.signature: T recruitment_nll(const InputData & data, const ParameterValues<T> & p, const Deviations<T> & dev)
symbols.purpose: Sum squared historical log recruitment deviations and the bias-weighted log-sigma contribution for the joint likelihood target.

symbols.name: IndexFit
symbols.documentation:
Index observation prediction, profiled catchability, residual, error and
unweighted likelihood contribution.
@details observation/prediction retain index fleet units, se is log-scale,
and log_q is analytically profiled catchability. nll is an unweighted
contribution; component lambdas are applied in the aggregate objective.
symbols.purpose: Index observation prediction, profiled catchability, residual, error and unweighted likelihood contribution.

symbols.name: LengthFit
symbols.documentation:
Length-sample prediction and diagnostics, including effective sample size,
observed/predicted means and deviance.
@details observed/expected are stabilized normalized bin proportions.
sample_size is the supplied effective N, means are cm, and nll is the
unweighted multinomial perfect-fit-offset contribution.
symbols.purpose: Length-sample prediction and diagnostics, including effective sample size, observed/predicted means and deviance.

symbols.name: LikelihoodResult
symbols.documentation:
Joint objective total, named weighted components, fitted indices and
included length-sample diagnostics.
@details total is the weighted joint objective. components keeps named terms
for SS3 comparisons, while indices/lengths retain per-observation
diagnostics. Profiled Q values do not add independent optimization
coordinates.
symbols.purpose: Joint objective total, named weighted components, fitted indices and included length-sample diagnostics.

symbols.name: evaluate_likelihood

symbols.purpose: Calculate catch, index, length-composition, recruitment and soft-bound components from a population trajectory; preserve all configured lambdas.

symbols.name: LocalCurvature
symbols.documentation: Full optimizer-coordinate covariance plus two-step numerical diagnostics.
symbols.purpose: Full independent-coordinate covariance from validated local curvature, with a second-step covariance and numerical diagnostics.

symbols.name: validated_local_curvature
symbols.signature: LocalCurvature validated_local_curvature(const Eigen::MatrixXd & coarse, const Eigen::MatrixXd & fine)
symbols.documentation:
Validate two finite-difference Hessians and invert positive local curvature.
Both steps must be symmetric/stable to 1e-5 relative norm, positive definite,
and give marginal SEs stable to 0.1%. Singular/indefinite curvature is rejected;
no eigenvalue clipping, ridge, diagonal-only approximation or saved covariance.
symbols.purpose: Validate two finite-difference Hessians for finite values, symmetry, step stability and positive definiteness, then invert without regularization and check SE stability.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel
symbols.documentation:
Quadra model adapter for the 84-coordinate joint penalized-likelihood
target; historical recruitment deviations are optimized, not
Laplace-integrated.
@details This is joint penalized maximum likelihood: recruitment deviations
are optimized parameters, not Laplace-integrated latent variables. The logit
is only an optimization reparameterization; no transformation-density
Jacobian is added. The dependent final main recruitment deviation is
reconstructed after transforming the independent coordinates.
symbols.purpose: Quadra model adapter for the 84-coordinate joint penalized-likelihood target; historical recruitment deviations are optimized, not Laplace-integrated.

symbols.name: SwordfishModel::FreeParameter
symbols.documentation:
One independent fitting coordinate: canonical name, native bounds/value
and optional recruitment year.
@details lo/hi/value are native bounds and the native starting value.
year=0 identifies a control parameter; a nonzero year identifies a
recruitment deviation. Its position in free defines the
covariance/gradient coordinate order.
symbols.purpose: One independent fitting coordinate: canonical name, native bounds/value and optional recruitment year.

symbols.signature: SwordfishModel::SwordfishModel(InputData input, ParameterValues<double> p, Deviations<double> deviations)
symbols.purpose: Build the fitting-coordinate schema from estimated control parameters and independent early/main recruitment deviations.

symbols.documentation:
Return canonical names in the same order as fitting coordinates and
covariance matrices.

covariance rows.

Transform interior native starting values to bounded-logit coordinates and
reject starts at or beyond bounds.

order.
symbols.purpose: Transform interior native starting values to bounded-logit coordinates and reject starts at or beyond bounds.

Create Quadra's parameter vector, treating every independent coordinate as
a joint optimized parameter.

optimized joint parameters.
symbols.purpose: Create Quadra's parameter vector, treating every independent coordinate as a joint optimized parameter.
